[TAB]Junil, the elder of the Gods, had promised to stay apart from the conflict in Creation. While other gods pressed the limits of the Compact or blatantly ignored it, he held to its restrictions and spirit. Even when his church was a mockery of his dominion, he would not respond. It was only when the compact was openly broken, when fallen angels walked in creation that he responded to help the least of men. He asked only one thing in return: unquestioning obedience. [PARAGRAPH:2]The Order was founded during the Age of Magic, not from divine inspiration but from the growing requirements of the Patrian bureaucracy. The codex of Patrian law had become so byzantine and severe that nearly autonomous inquisitors were needed to carry out it requirements. These inquisitors were magically bound to the codex so that they wouldn't become corrupted by their station. They drew upon the name of Junil, God of Law, in taking their oaths and in carrying out their brutal decrees. [PARAGRAPH:1]These inquisitors were feared nearly as much as Kylorin's Archmages and would come to a city to adjudicate major disputes and to see that justice, as defined by the codex of Patria, was followed. [PARAGRAPH:1]At the head of the church was Soqed Hozi. It is said that if she spoke a lie, reality would change to make it into truth. Soqed had a mute twin who was little more than a dim shadow of her powerful sister. The two remained at the Temple of Atonement where they oversaw the church and its inquisitors. [PARAGRAPH:1]The ideology of Junil was secondary to the church's task of maintaining the laws of Patria. Some lesser confessors began to question: "What was the use of following the law if it was corrupt?". The most conflicted of these was Sphener, an inquisitor who killed demons in his service to the church. He had gazed into hell and it was only his strict adherence to his faith that allowed him to survive. Sphener obeyed every edict of the church, but argued that worship of Junil was the greatest mission of the church. [PARAGRAPH:1]The church found out about the whispered concerns of some of its members and launched the Purge of Whispers, and attempt to execute anyone in the church who questioned church doctrine. [PARAGRAPH:1]The purge was horribly effective and killed members of the church, family and friends. It covered many cities over all of Patria and happened in a single night. Sphener was one of the few that escaped the purge and the next day the church held a trial for him in absentia. They convicted him and sentenced him to death upon the wheel. Condemned by his law, his church, and his god, Sphener came to the church on his own and accepted his execution. He was broken as the church elders and the public watched. [PARAGRAPH:1]Over the next decade Sphener's spirit was seen hundreds of times tending to those in need. He tended to those unfairly persecuted by the church and ministered to church members that prayed to Junil for guidance. This became the basis for the new Order church that would be founded in the Age of Rebirth. One may prevent the spread of another into a city, or drive the other out.


[PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Angels of [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\LINK], amd the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]The Brotherhood of Wardens[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK]. It will be strengthened in Good lands and weakened in Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_LAW]Law Mana[\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TEMPLE_OF_ATONEMENT]Temple of Atonement[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITADEL]Citadels[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CASTLE]Castles[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_FORT]Forts[\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK]. It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_CHAOS]Chaos Mana[\LINK] and [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CARNIVEANS_CRAG]Carnivean's Craig[\LINK].

[TAB]Kilmorph is the goddess of the earth, She Who Dwells Beneath. She formed children out of stone, the Dwarves, and taught them the secrets of metalworking. One of the first religions available to the men of the world, Kilmorph will answer the prayers of honorable men and even send her soldiers to defend their cities. [PARAGRAPH][ICON_BULLET]A priest of the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK] will have its arda most strengthened by the influence of the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]The Eternal Cabal[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]The Laeran Cord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\LINK]. It will be strengthened in Good or Neutral lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_EARTH]Earth Mana[\LINK], Peaks, Hills, the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_STANDING_STONES]Standing Stones[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MINE]Mines[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_QUARRY]Quarries[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_FORT]Forts[\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK]. It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_AIR]Air Mana[\LINK], flatlands, rivers, Flood Plains, and water. It is stronger the longer the unit has been fortifying in place.
